definitions.explanation: Lavish and costly in a showy, splendid way. A literary word, used for decoration, buildings and ways of living.

examples.japanese: {豪奢|ごうしゃ}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧。
{豪奢|ごうしゃ}な⟦シャンデリア→シャンデリア：30916_shanderia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。

⟦{王族|おうぞく}→王族：13587_ouzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{埋|う}め→埋める：01901_umeru⟧⟦{尽|つ}くされた→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧{豪奢|ごうしゃ}な{造|つく}りだった。
examples.english: The royal palace was a sumptuous building covered in gold ornament.

notes:
Literary; in conversation ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ or ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧ is usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豪奢|ごうしゃ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a luxurious life
- {豪奢|ごうしゃ}な⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧: sumptuous decoration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧: gorgeous, deluxe; the everyday word
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧: luxury, extravagance; often with a sense of waste

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{号車|ごうしゃ}→号車：19765_gousha⟧ "car number (on a train)" has the same reading.
